Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

[Source: help_centre/installation_setup.md, article_id: KB-005, section: Installation and first-time setup > Installation timelines, chunk #1]
Installation and first-time setup > Installation timelines
Free installation within 48 hours applies to the AirFiber_1199_1M and AirFiber_1999_3M plans. The AirFiber_599_1M plan is installed within 5 working days and carries a one-time installation charge of ₹500.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

AirFiber Refund Policy
Effective date: 1 August 2026

Customers may request a refund within 7 days of first installation if measured speed stays below 50% of the subscribed plan during three official speed tests.

Refunds are not available for:
- Partial months on prepaid packs after the 7-day window
- Charges for optional OTT add-ons once the promo code is redeemed
- Equipment that is damaged or not returned

Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days.

How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

The status LED on the front of the AirFiber ONT reports the state of the fiber line.

| LED colour | Pattern | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Green | Solid | Line is active and authenticated | No action needed |
| Green | Slow blink | Negotiating with the exchange | Wait up to 3 minutes |
| Red | Solid | No optical signal reaching the ONT | Check the fiber cable for sharp bends, then raise a Line Fault ticket |
| Red | Blinking | Fiber cut detected between the home and the exchange | Raise a Line Fault ticket; a field engineer visit is required |
| Orange | Solid | Authenticated but no WAN IP assigned | Power-cycle the ONT for 30 seconds |
| Orange | Blinking | Firmware upgrade in progress | Do not power off; wait 10 minutes |
| Off | — | No power to the ONT | Check the adapter and wall socket |

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Customers may request a refund within 7 days of first installation if measured speed stays below 50% of the subscribed plan during three official speed tests.

- Charges for optional OTT add-ons once the promo code is redeemed
- Equipment that is damaged or not returned

Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days.

To raise a refund request, open a ticket in the AirFiber app and attach the three speed-test screenshots. Support ticket category: Billing > Refund.

You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Effective date: 1 August 2026

Customers may request a refund within 7 days of first installation if measured speed stays below 50% of the subscribed plan during three official speed tests.

Refunds are not available for:
- Partial months on prepaid packs after the 7-day window
- Charges for optional OTT add-ons once the promo code is redeemed
- Equipment that is damaged or not returned

Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days.

To raise a refund request, open a ticket in the AirFiber app and attach the three speed-test screenshots. Support ticket category: Billing > Refund.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

Troubleshooting AirFiber connectivity > Router LED status reference
The status LED on the front of the AirFiber ONT reports the state of the fiber line.

| LED colour | Pattern | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Green | Solid | Line is active and authenticated | No action needed |
| Green | Slow blink | Negotiating with the exchange | Wait up to 3 minutes |
| Red | Solid | No optical signal reaching the ONT | Check the fiber cable for sharp bends, then raise a Line Fault ticket |
| Red | Blinking | Fiber cut detected between the home and the exchange | Raise a Line Fault ticket; a field engineer visit is required |
| Orange | Solid | Authenticated but no WAN IP assigned | Power-cycle the ONT for 30 seconds |
| Orange | Blinking | Firmware upgrade in progress | Do not power off; wait 10 minutes |
| Off | — | No power to the ONT | Check the adapter and wall socket |

[Source: help_centre/troubleshooting_connectivity.md, article_id: KB-004, section: Troubleshooting AirFiber connectivity > Error codes, chunk #2]

The AirFiber app shows an error code when a session cannot be established.

| Code | Meaning | Resolution | Escalate after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AF-401 | Credentials rejected by the exchange | Re-enter the account ID in the app | 2 attempts |
| AF-408 | Session timed out during handshake | Power-cycle the ONT | 3 attempts |
| AF-503 | Exchange port is oversubscribed | Wait 15 minutes and retry; if it persists, request a port reallocation from support | 1 hour |
| AF-511 | MAC address not whitelisted | Register the router MAC under Account > Devices | Immediately |
| AF-620 | Optical power below -27 dBm | Field engineer visit required; raise a Line Fault ticket | Immediately |

Troubleshooting AirFiber connectivity > Router LED status reference
The status LED on the front of the AirFiber ONT reports the state of the fiber line.

| LED colour | Pattern | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Green | Solid | Line is active and authenticated | No action needed |
| Green | Slow blink | Negotiating with the exchange | Wait up to 3 minutes |
| Red | Solid | No optical signal reaching the ONT | Check the fiber cable for sharp bends, then raise a Line Fault ticket |
| Red | Blinking | Fiber cut detected between the home and the exchange | Raise a Line Fault ticket; a field engineer visit is required |
| Orange | Solid | Authenticated but no WAN IP assigned | Power-cycle the ONT for 30 seconds |
| Orange | Blinking | Firmware upgrade in progress | Do not power off; wait 10 minutes |
| Off | — | No power to the ONT | Check the adapter and wall socket |

[Source: help_centre/troubleshooting_connectivity.md, article_id: KB-004, section: Troubleshooting AirFiber connectivity > Official speed tests, chunk #4]
Troubleshooting AirFiber connectivity > Official speed tests
An official speed test must be run from the AirFiber app, on a device connected by ethernet cable, with no other device active on the line. Tests run on third-party websites or over Wi-Fi are not accepted as evidence for a refund claim.

How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.

AirFiber Refund Policy
Effective date: 1 August 2026

Customers may request a refund within 7 days of first installation if measured speed stays below 50% of the subscribed plan during three official speed tests.

Refunds are not available for:
- Partial months on prepaid packs after the 7-day window
- Charges for optional OTT add-ons once the promo code is redeemed
- Equipment that is damaged or not returned

Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 business days.

To raise a refund request, open a ticket in the AirFiber app and attach the three speed-test screenshots. Support ticket category: Billing > Refund.

Billing and payments FAQ
How do I pay for AirFiber?
You can pay by UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking in the AirFiber app or on airfiber.example.com/pay.

When is my bill generated?
Prepaid plans are charged at the start of the pack. Postpaid bills are generated on the 1st of each month and are due within 7 days.

What happens if payment fails?
If auto-pay fails, we retry twice over 48 hours. After that the connection is moved to a 5-day grace period at reduced speed (2 Mbps). After grace, the line is suspended.

Can I get an invoice?
Yes. PDF invoices are emailed to the registered address and can be downloaded from Account > Invoices.

Is there a late fee?
Postpaid accounts incur a late fee of ₹100 if the bill is unpaid 7 days after the due date. Prepaid packs are not charged a late fee because service simply expires.
